Connect your machine

Agents run on your computer. One command signs you in, links this repository, installs the agent skills and starts the bridge.

1. Install the CLI
Terminal
curl -fsSL https://app.loupe.ac/install.sh | sh
 2. Run it in your repository
~/code/acme
loupe init --project acme
 Safe to run again. It skips what is already done.
